name: AltTextify.net
author: thetawavetechnologies

sections.description:
AltTextify.net uses state of the art AI models and computer vision / “image to text” to generate accurate, descriptive alt text that enhances ADA compliance, improves search engine rankings, and saves you hours of manual work.

🖼️ Automatic Alt Text Insertion: Every newly uploaded image is instantly analyzed using AI, and descriptive alt text is automatically applied to enhance accessibility and image SEO.

📁 Broad Format Compatibility: Seamlessly supports all major image formats — including JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, and AVIF — ensuring consistent performance across modern websites and e-commerce platforms.

🔍 Keyword-optimized alt text: Automatically pulls focus keyphrases from leading SEO plugins like All in One SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, SmartCrawl, Squirrly SEO, The SEO Framework, and Yoast SEO for natural, SEO-friendly descriptions.

🛒 SEO-Enhanced for WooCommerce: Specifically optimized for WooCommerce stores, AltTextify intelligently incorporates product titles into alt text to boost search engine visibility and product discoverability.

🌍 Multilingual Support: Generate alt text in over 140 languages, enabling global accessibility, localization, and compliance with international content standards.

♿ Accessibility Compliance Meet critical accessibility guidelines including ADA, WCAG 2.1, and Section 508 with auto-generated alt text designed to be both meaningful and compliant.

📦 Bulk Alt Text Generation: Quickly update your entire media library using our Bulk Generate tool or WordPress media bulk action menu — ideal for existing image collections.

🆓 Instant Free Trial – No Credit Card Required: Get started instantly with our free trial. No payment details needed. Experience the full power of AltTextify without commitment.

Help

Need assistance? The AltTextify plugin comes with detailed documentation for every step.

Contactus

Have questions? Reach out to us — we’re here to help!
sections.installation:
1. **Navigate ** Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “AltTextify” in the plugin directory
  3. Install and Activate the AltTextify plugin from the results
  4. Visit https://alttextify.net to create your free account or select a plan
  5. Connect your account by copying your API key in the Alt Text AI plugin settings
  6. Upload any image — alt text will be generated automatically with AI!
